metadata.title: Cemiplimab Therapy
metadata.indication: Adults with recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer after platinum progression, or metastatic/locally advanced cutaneous SCC not suitable for curative surgery or radiation (separate eligibility contexts).
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no preset total number of cycles.

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Current NCCP source reconciled; independent clinical and pharmacy approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Fresh full PDF retained and rule boundaries exercised. Software/source reconciliation is not independent clinical approval.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: No dose reductions are recommended. Hold/stop decisions do not calculate a reduced immune-checkpoint dose. Restart requires organ-specific recovery and consultant review; no recovery flag overrides permanent-stop criteria.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00812 version 3a. Independent clinical and oncology-pharmacy validation remains pending. The current official regimen and prescribing consultant remain authoritative.

indications.description: Recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer progressing on or after platinum-based chemotherapy.
Metastatic or locally advanced cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma in a patient who is not a candidate for curative surgery or curative radiation.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cemiplimab 350 mg IV over 30 minutes on day 1 every 21 days until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no preset total number of cycles.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST actual result (highest ×ULN calculated automatically)
alt_ast_uln_multiple.assessment_guidance: Use the actual result divided by the same assay upper limit of normal. AST/ALT is the higher transaminase ratio; verify etiology and baseline. Never substitute a creatinine or baseline ratio.

bilirubin_uln_multiple.assessment_guidance: Use the actual result divided by the same assay upper limit of normal. AST/ALT is the higher transaminase ratio; verify etiology and baseline. Never substitute a creatinine or baseline ratio.

eligibility: Adults with an NCCP-listed indication; ECOG0–2; adequate haematological, hepatic and renal function.
Cervical: recurrent/metastatic disease progressing on or after platinum-based chemotherapy.
CSCC: metastatic/locally advanced disease not suitable for curative surgery or curative radiation; at least one measurable lesion. NCCP00812v3a does not include adjuvant CSCC.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to the drug(s) or excipients; follow the current NCCP source for all exclusions and cautions.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00812v 3a p 6: cemiplimab minimal emetogenic potential; no routine premedication, local policy.
supportive_care.immune_toxicity_note: Immune-toxicity steroids, endocrine replacement and other management are organ-specific specialist treatment, not routine premedication.
